feature_note: The uncial M, reached from M through the stylistic set ss01 (the uncial forms) until Q34 decides the defaults.
description: The uncial M: two round bowls side by side, joined by a straight stem between their counters, standing on a thin bar that runs under both with a curl at each end. Each bowl's outside comes down into the bar at a notch inside its curl. On top, the stem rises between the bowls to a pointed peak, with a notch each side. The counters are tall ovals, narrowing at the foot toward the outside. Symmetric about its axis.
